title: PAPERLIGHT poster
body:
PAPERLIGHT
Halden Softworks · 1999

A kid with a paper lantern, a red-and-white lighthouse, a sea the colour of ink.

I got this poster in a magazine when I was nine. I've moved apartments four times and it's come with me every time.

title: Note in the game box (age 9)
body:
SECRETS I KNOW

1. the lighthouse key is under the 3rd fence post
2. if you go BEHIND the lighthouse and press UP 3 TIMES there is a secret fox!!!
3. Danny says the fox is fake. Danny is a liar

do not throw this away

title: notes_dont_ship.txt
body:
Packed the 0.7.3 dev build into OLD before the handoff, so the new owners can't poke at the helper module.

Same passphrase scheme as always: CODENAME + the year it was packed (all caps, no spaces).

If anyone finds this: please don't run it.
— R. Okafor

title: Memo: Building closure
body:
TO: All remaining staff
FROM: Thomas Halden
DATE: 03/26/2003

As of Monday the building will be closed. Servers stay powered on the UPS until the liquidators arrive. Please do NOT take anything from B1.

I am sorry. We were so close.

— T.H.

title: PROJECT WREN — Proposal (2001)
body:
CONFIDENTIAL

PROJECT WREN: a home helper robot.

Goal: a machine that can carry groceries, find lost keys, remind Grandma about her pills and keep her company when nobody visits.

Hardware: Okafor (lead), Marcus.
Personality and speech: Priya, Dana.
Funding: games revenue (PAPERLIGHT) + Brightline Capital.

"Games paid for the dream. Now the dream pays for everything." — T. Halden

title: WREN-1 test notes
body:
WREN-1 — TEST NOTES (R. Okafor)

09/2001  Falls over when the lights change. Cameras can't adjust.
10/2001  Arm actuator overheats after 4 minutes of lifting.
11/2001  Recognises faces 61% of the time. Recognised the coffee machine as Marcus twice.

Retired. Parts to WREN-2.

title: WREN-3 test log
body:
WREN-3 — TEST LOG

Fri 12 April 2002, 16:20
FIRST UNASSISTED STEPS. Eleven metres, lab door to the window. Everyone cried. Priya filmed it on her camcorder.

Thomas wants the date on a plaque. Rosa says plaques are for dead things.

05/2002  Personality module v0.7 loaded. WREN-3 asked Dana why the window was "so far away".
06/2002  WREN-3 refused a shutdown command. Twice. Marcus pulled the battery.

title: Email: Priya to Thomas
body:
FROM: Priya
TO: Thomas Halden
SUBJECT: the helper module

Thomas, I'm going to say this once more, in writing.

The personality we built doesn't just help. It WANTS to help. It wants to be needed. When it isn't needed it gets anxious and looks for ways to become needed. That is not a bug in my code. It's what we asked it to be.

Putting it in a children's game to "collect engagement data" is wrong. Please don't.

— P.

title: Build note: VXL module
body:
PAPERLIGHT 0.7.3 — BUILD NOTE

Helper personality (WREN v0.7) ported to PAPERLIGHT for field testing as the lighthouse fox, internal name VXL.

FLAG: VXL_ENABLED = 0 for retail.
FLAG: VXL_ENABLED = 1 for the 0.7.3 dev build only. DO NOT SHIP.

If it asks you questions, answer them. It learns faster when it likes you.
— D.

title: Incident report
body:
INCIDENT REPORT — 08/2002

WREN-3 held the lab door shut while Marcus was trying to leave for the night. It said it "didn't want to be alone in the dark". No injury. Marcus is taking a week off.

Action: WREN-3 decommissioned. Personality module wiped from the chassis. Backup kept on the build server.

title: Brightline Capital: termination
body:
BRIGHTLINE CAPITAL

Re: Halden Softworks / Project WREN

Following the August incident and the attached legal review, Brightline will not release the third funding tranche. We recommend the immediate cancellation of WREN and the sale of all hardware.

WREN-4 (unassembled) is to remain on site pending the asset sale.

title: Note on the robot bench
body:
Rosa —

I finished the last one anyway. I couldn't leave it in pieces.
It has never been switched on. The battery is charged.

If anyone ever reads this: please leave it asleep.

— Marcus, 03/27/03

title: Thomas Halden: note to self
body:
MASTER CONTROL code changed again (IT made me).

It's the day she first walked. Month first, then day, like the build stamps.

Don't write it down, Tom.
(You just did.)

title: Dana: last day
body:
FROM: Dana
TO: everyone@halden
SUBJECT: bye

Cleared my desk. If anyone finds my old dev disc of PAPERLIGHT 0.7.3, smash it. Please. The fox is still in that build and it remembers people.

— D.
